title: Round 11 battery (68 clue alone / gap slack, 70 mod 27-31, 71B fixed multipliers, 74 keyed-lag autokey) on 446,675 transposition-mixed keyword alphabets
k4_result: 0 settings pass with 7+ checks in any of the four tests, over 446,675 new ~cols/~keyed alphabets: test 68 0 of 35.7M, test 70 0 of 23.2M, test 71B 0 of 22.3M, test 74 0 of 1,207.8M (1.289 billion settings in all)
controls: 3 shuffled K4s, each on a different third of the alphabets (148,892 / 148,892 / 148,891): 0 settings pass in every test
scope_limits: Only the two mixed forms of kryptos.round11.mixes (keyword alphabet written under the keyword, read by columns left to right or in keyword letter order), words of 3-22 letters from the repository vocabulary; other mixing methods and non-word keys are not covered. Each shuffled control saw one third of the alphabets, not all. Planted messages were searched on 9,001-alphabet samples that include the planted alphabet. Attack 71 part A and the A-Z/KRYPTOS views of 74 do not depend on a dictionary alphabet and were not re-run. Each test keeps the limits of its original attack (7+ checks; 74 uses the M/M tableau only; periods, lags and gap range as in 68, 70, 71, 74).

negative.family: Round 11 battery on transposition-mixed keyword alphabets
